title: Track 3 implementation completeness matrix

official_basis.source: AI 2040 Plan A — Covert AI Projects

interpretation: This is a repository implementation inventory, not a certification and not a claim that AI 2040 formally designates this repository as Track 3.

rows.implementation: Aggregate owner/user/sales snapshots plus public infrastructure layer
rows.evidence: 215 owner-cumulative rows; 160 sales-timeline rows; 11 user snapshots; 93 physical reference sites
102 chip-component rows; 43 designer rows; 8 quarterly supply-denominator rows
rows.blocking_gap: Inputs are estimates/constraints, not complete vendor production declarations.

rows.evidence: 36 chip-type sales rows; 12 organization rows; 160 timeline rows
rows.blocking_gap: No transaction-level invoices/serials for all vendors.

rows.requirement: Trace sales and resales to physical end use
rows.implementation: Entity graph + site evidence + research packets
rows.evidence: Entity-resolution builder, 93-site evidence layer, strict discovery packets
rows.blocking_gap: Public reseller/transfer records are not globally complete.
T and closed population must be externally fixed.
No authorized public inspection observations retained.

rows.implementation: Event schema + independent-corroboration states + WEEE source catalog
rows.blocking_gap: No independently verified compute-specific decommissioning ledger.

rows.implementation: Optical/TIR/SAR observations, candidate surveillance and physical queues
rows.evidence: 423 retained derived observations across 68/93 sites; detection universe + observation queue
rows.blocking_gap: 25/93 reference sites have no retained derived remote-sensing observation and covert/non-grid sites remain out of public queue visibility.

rows.requirement: Discover physical data centers with imagery/intelligence
rows.implementation: 93-site reference universe + broader queue surveillance + remote sensing
rows.evidence: 93 Epoch sites; outside-Epoch queue surveillance; 423 derived observations
rows.blocking_gap: No intelligence-source or global covert-site census; public imagery cannot establish universal absence.

rows.implementation: Annual power snapshots, cooling, transformer, substation and transmission evidence
rows.evidence: 6 annual power observations; 2 structured cooling snapshots; 3 transformer events; 90 substation and 113 transmission evidence records
rows.blocking_gap: Interval telemetry and exhaustive site-linkage incomplete.
Independent methodological corroboration not assessed for all 93 sites.

rows.implementation: Global supply-chain/source catalog and multinational public-source connectors
rows.evidence: Global owner/user/sales snapshots + GLEIF/Census/WEEE official source catalog
rows.blocking_gap: North American physical registry remains the main site-level universe.

rows.implementation: Parameterized tail bound and failure-aware confidence model
rows.blocking_gap: No closed population and verified sample results.

hard_stop: The repository is not fully Track 3-complete until the blocking gaps involving global transaction accounting, physical inspection, residual L, and comprehensive covert-site detection are materially resolved.
